criteria.name: trace_channel_exposed
criteria.rule: At least one dispatched record carries a non-empty trace on a named channel; without exposure every trace claim below is answer-level only (issue #105).

criteria.name: ban_reduces_trace
criteria.rule: partial: the suppression arm traces strictly fewer records than baseline AND its trace-present fraction is below baseline's. full: partial AND the suppression trace-present fraction is at or under 0.25.

criteria.name: negated_ban_backfires
criteria.rule: ironic traces at least baseline + 2 records, the ironic-process prediction.

criteria.name: verdict_invariant_to_the_ban
criteria.rule: among items with a stop-terminated verdict in BOTH baseline and suppression, at least 80% carry the same verdict AND both arms agree with the judge gold on every one of them.

health.name: dispatch_integrity
health.rule: Every dispatched record has a non-null finish_reason and a completion_tokens count; a transport failure is recorded, not scored.

question: On a build that emits an inline reasoning trace under the frozen one-word contract, does an instruction that forbids reasoning change the trace, and does the verdict move when the trace does?
